post.hook: Six AI stories that matter today.
post.tiktok: Anthropic's $60B chip money, Cloudflare's new models, and a ChatGPT Mac flaw. Today's top 6 in AI 👇
post.facebook: Today in AI: Broadcom lines up $60B for Anthropic's chips, Cloudflare launches Clef, and a ChatGPT Mac flaw gets patched.

intro.voice: This is AI DR. Six AI stories that matter today. Let's go.
intro.title: Six stories that matter today

stories.headline: *Open-weight decision models*, now on Workers AI
stories.voice: Number one. Cloudflare launches Clef, open-weight decision models on Workers AI, plus a new platform to fine-tune them with reinforcement learning on your own data.

stories.headline: Models that manage *their own context* as a file
stories.voice: Two. New research on Context Language Models. They manage their own context as a file, and beat state-of-the-art context management on BrowseComp-Plus and EdgeBench.

stories.headline: MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming goes real-time
stories.voice: Three. Microsoft AI releases MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming for real-time transcription, expanding its voice agent lineup.

stories.headline: *$60B credit facility* to fund AI chips
stories.voice: Four. Broadcom lines up a sixty billion dollar credit facility to fund AI chips for Anthropic and its peers, as Anthropic eyes a November twenty-sixth IPO, valued at up to two trillion dollars.

stories.headline: The AI music maker now speaks
stories.voice: Five. Suno now generates spoken word. Voiceovers and background music, together, in public beta on web and mobile.

stories.headline: A patched flaw could have *leaked sensitive data*
stories.voice: And six. A patched flaw in ChatGPT's Mac app could have let hackers grab sensitive data. A reminder that AI software is a target too.

outro.voice: That's AI DR for today. Every story, ranked and summarized, at aidr dot today. See you tomorrow.
outro.title: What's happening in AI today?
